name: admin-alb-response-time
title: Admin responses are consistently slow
description: The admin average response time has exceeded 1.5 seconds during at least seven of the last ten minutes, excluding the pre-registration CSV process.
investigation_steps: Review the matching logs to identify slow admin request paths.
Check admin and API task health, CPU, memory and task counts.
Check for slow database queries, failed dependencies or recent deployments that might have caused this.
Check for wider infrastructure issues that might be affecting response times, including problems with AWS services.

query: fields @timestamp, service_name, upstream_response_time, request_uri, status, real_forwarded_for, @message, @logStream
